definitions.explanation: Money going out of an account or being withdrawn.

examples.japanese: ⟦ATM→ATM：08755_eetiiemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出金|しゅっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To withdraw money from an ATM.

examples.japanese: {出金|しゅっきん}⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出金|しゅっきん}⟦{限度額|げんどがく}→限度額：20870_gendogaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧50⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The daily withdrawal limit is 500,000 yen.

notes:
{出金|しゅっきん} refers to money leaving an account — whether through ATM withdrawal, bank transfer, or disbursement. Used in banking, accounting, and financial contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出金|しゅっきん}⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: withdrawal fee
- {出金|しゅっきん}⟦{限度額|げんどがく}→限度額：20870_gendogaku⟧: withdrawal limit
- {出金|しゅっきん}⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧: withdrawal history
- {出金|しゅっきん}⟦{伝票|でんぴょう}→伝票：07487_denpyou⟧: withdrawal slip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出金|しゅっきん}: money going out (withdrawal/disbursement)
- ⟦{入金|にゅうきん}→入金：05467_nyuukin⟧: money coming in (deposit/payment received)

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ (going to work) — different kanji, completely different meaning.
